thread:
Anna (Docs): Quick sync — want to lock down the docs voice/tenor guidance for the Q2 migration. We still have mismatches in SDK snippets and the glossary canonical IDs. Who can own a short checklist?

Matt R: I can take point on the PR conflicts side. Saw ~4 open PRs that touch param casing and examples. Will try to rebase tonight.

Jules P: Thanks Matt. Can we do one canonical glossary id per concept and then map alias variants in a small table? That way docs links and redirects stay consistent.

Anna (Docs): Yes — exactly. Thinking minimal spec: 1) canonical id, 2) preferred display name, 3) SDK param example, 4) shortcode/aliases for search. Short checklist to ship to writers.

Diego (SDK): I can update the SDK snippets to use the canonical param casing once we have the list. Heads up: changing param names in examples affects both JS and Python snippets. I can prepare a tiny script to replace tokens: 
```bash
# run from repo root
python scripts/update_snippets.py --map glossary_map.yaml
```
Will add a quick test to ensure snippet compilation.

Matt R: Nice. For the PR collision plan: I'll create a gating PR that adds the glossary_map.yaml to /docs/data and then smaller PRs can reference it. If anyone is about to push a snippet change, please stop and comment on this thread.

Anna (Docs): CI: can we run link checks + snippet compile as part of the gating PR? Need to catch broken links and param mismatches.

ci-bot: link-checker found 3 broken links in docs/guide/migration.md -> /api/paramcase (404)

Diego (SDK): I'll patch migration.md after we land the mapping. Can someone file a short issue for the 404 so we track it?

Jules P: I filed #4822: "migration.md broken link + canonical id mapping" and added a short list of suggested canonical ids in the issue body.

Anna (Docs): Solid. Next steps: 
- Matt: open gating PR with docs/data/glossary_map.yaml by EOD.
- Diego: stub update_snippets.py and snippet compile test by tomorrow.
- Jules: final review of canonical ids and aliases in #4822.
- Anna: write the short checklist and sample table for writers (will post here).

Matt R: FWIW I'll also add a CI label to the PR to prevent merges until link-check and snippet-compile pass.

Diego (SDK): Quick question: for SDK examples, do we switch to "param_name" or "paramName"? We have mixed uses.

Anna (Docs): Decision: prefer snake_case in docs examples for param names (align with Python readability), but include a note in each SDK snippet block showing the language-specific mapping (JS: camelCase). Example: 
```python
# python (docs canonical example)
client.create(payload, timeout_seconds=30)
```
```javascript
// js mapped example for clarity
client.create(payload, timeoutSeconds: 30)
```
Add a short one-line note above the snippet explaining the mapping.

Jules P: Agree. That keeps docs readable while being explicit. Also add glossary entry: "param-case" with mappings.

ci-bot: gating PR #525 opened by Matt R, checks queued.

Matt R: I'll @-mention the release-cue reviewers once tests finish.

Anna (Docs): Thanks all. I'll draft the checklist and post it here in the morning for quick thumbs. :thumbsup:

Diego (SDK): 👍 will watch the PR and start the snippet script.

Jules P: LGTM — will audit existing glossary links after the gating PR lands.

Anna (Docs): If anyone finds stray variants (like "paramCase", "param-case"), drop them in the issue thread so we can alias them.

Matt R: Noted. I'll add a small grep script to search repo for common variants and post results.

Anna (Docs): Awesome, closing this thread for now — will reopen if blockers pop up.

ci-bot: gating PR #525 passed link-check and snippet-compile checks (all green).
